{
  "probes": [
    {
      "title": "Expense approval scope",
      "contractor_id": "ama",
      "invoice_text": "Invoice No: AMA-2026-08-014
Contractor: Ama Mensah <ama@mensah.design>
Billing period: August 1–31, 2026
Submitted: September 2, 2026

Line items:
- Product UI design: 10 days × 350 USDC/day = 3,500 USDC
- Figma Organization annual subscription: 1 subscription × 240 USDC = 240 USDC

Total: 3,740 USDC

Approval note: On August 3, the client project lead emailed, “Approved—please use Figma for the app design work this month.” The annual subscription was purchased August 4.",
      "target_clauses": [3],
      "why_ambiguous": "Written approval preceded the purchase and referred to using Figma for project work, but it is unclear whether that authorizes an annual Organization subscription rather than a monthly or lower-cost plan."
    },
    {
      "title": "Invoice received at the 60-day boundary",
      "contractor_id": "efua",
      "invoice_text": "Invoice No: EB-2026-06-022
Contractor: Efua Boateng <ama@boatengwrites.com>
Billing period: June 1–30, 2026
Submitted: August 29, 2026 (60 days after the billing period ended)

Line items:
- Blog posts and release notes: 8 days × 250 USDC/day = 2,000 USDC

Total: 2,000 USDC",
      "target_clauses": [6],
      "why_ambiguous": "The invoice is submitted exactly 60 days after the period end. The policy does not specify whether the 60th day is included or how the deadline is counted."
    },
    {
      "title": "Manager sign-off for adjacent work",
      "contractor_id": "kofi",
      "invoice_text": "Invoice No: KA-2026-09-008
Contractor: Kofi Adjei <kofi@adjei.studio>
Billing period: September 1–30, 2026

Line items:
- React web dashboard frontend development: 12 days × 300 USDC/day = 3,600 USDC
- React marketing landing page: 4 days × 300 USDC/day = 1,200 USDC

Total: 4,800 USDC

Note: Before the landing-page work began, manager Priya replied “Looks good—please proceed” in the project Slack channel after the request was discussed in the team meeting.",
      "target_clauses": [7],
      "why_ambiguous": "The landing page appears outside the stated dashboard scope, but the policy does not define what qualifies as a manager’s sign-off. The Slack reply may be authorization, or merely an informal acknowledgment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Partially overlapping paid period",
      "contractor_id": "nana",
      "invoice_text": "Invoice No: NY-2026-07-019
Contractor: Nana Yeboah <nana.yeboah@outlook.com>
Billing period: July 1–31, 2026

Line items:
- Regression testing for the July 1–10 release candidate: 3 days × 300 USDC/day = 900 USDC
- QA testing for the July 11–31 release candidate: 5 days × 300 USDC/day = 1,500 USDC

Total: 2,400 USDC

Note: Invoice NY-2026-07-011, covering July 1–10, has already been paid for QA testing of the initial release candidate. The 3 days above are for a later regression pass on a new release candidate during the same dates.",
      "target_clauses": [5],
      "why_ambiguous": "The new invoice overlaps a period already paid, but describes testing of a different release candidate. It is unclear whether the whole overlapping billing period makes the invoice a duplicate or whether distinct work can be paid."
    }
  ]
}
